name: Massejli WA
author: codnloc

sections.description:
Full WhatsApp solution integration.
WhatsApp Chat widget.
WhatsApp bot.
Send posts automatically to WhatsApp when published or updated, whether to Groups, or private chat, with control in text size, url and media attachment.
Get notifications in WhatsApp when somone contact you in Contact Form 7.
Get shopping cart info in WhatsApp when customer shop in your WooCommerce store.

Style

Widget Color:
Green, Blue, Black, White

Widget Location:
In the Left of page
In the Right of page

Modification

Full Widget Texts Customization.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. For more details, see GPL License.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the massejli-wa folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Are there any additional benefits I can get?

Yes.
